meta.notes: Nothing is held out: the hyper-parameters were fitted on the whole history. Home advantage and draw propensity come from a trailing five-season window, so every number the model used at kick-off was available before kick-off. The model has real skill only from about 1960 on; before that, knowing the era's home-draw-away split is almost as good as knowing the teams.
